_readme: Source-cited research for the 32 free schools nearest the demo address (2250 NW 2nd Ave). Collected 2026-10-17 with an AI research assistant, one cited value per field (source_url + as_of + confidence); null means not found. Spot-check a value by opening its source_url. `hidden` removes a school from search/pathway results (stays reachable by id): remove an id to show it again. Re-run: replace `schools` with a new file in the same shape, then `python -m app.ingest.build`.
